tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is already covered. The unresolved question is whether a second sink activates under joint input and gradient conditions. No paid row exceeds s_grad = 2.2, so the data cannot test the supercritical regime suggested by the recalled mechanism. The trajectory batch is the remaining relevant probe.

considered_alternatives.option: Confirm the smooth saturating input–gradient model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits all six rows to rounding precision, but a conditional siphon that is inactive at those settings would fit equally well.
The acquired row had s_grad = 0.30 and matched the smooth baseline; repeating that setting would not test siphon activation.
The nuisance measurement does not distinguish the smooth baseline from a conditional siphon.
